Enrich person.name: Sandra Ivette Báez
Enrich person.title: SVP - New Accounts, AML & Fraud Risk Manager
Enrich person.summary:
I am a senior financial services executive with leadership experience across Broker-Dealer Operations, Wealth Management, Business Supervision, Client Onboarding, Client Service, Operational Risk, and AML & Financial Crimes within complex, highly regulated organizations.
  
Throughout my career, I have led operations and governance initiatives that connect business performance, client experience, operational effectiveness, and risk management. I bring a practical understanding of both the business and control environments, with experience supporting financial advisors, high-net-worth clients, client-facing teams, and senior leadership across U.S. and international markets, including Latin America.
  
My leadership experience spans four interconnected areas:
  
• Operations & Client Services: Broker-Dealer Operations, Wealth Management, Client Onboarding, Client Service, Account Administration, Process Improvement, Workflow Optimization, and Operational Excellence.
  
• Business & Advisor Support: First-Line Sales Supervision, Advisor Support, Business Management, Branch Operations, Business Governance, Performance Management, and Cross-Functional Leadership.
  
• Risk & Governance: Operational Risk, Regulatory Controls, Supervisory Frameworks, Governance, Issue Resolution, Regulatory Examinations, and Remediation.
  
• AML & Financial Crimes: AML, KYC, CIP, CDD, EDD, High-Risk Client Governance, and Financial Crimes Risk Management.
  
I have built and strengthened operating models, improved governance, supported regulatory requirements, and led teams through complex business and operational challenges. My approach is grounded in sound judgment, collaboration, disciplined execution, and practical risk management.
  
I connect business, operations, client experience, and the control environment to identify opportunities, strengthen execution, manage risk, and enable sustainable business growth.
